only sharp consumer (resize/fit/cover/toFile); verify API compat on 0.35

analysis.summary: sharp is a devDependency at ^0.34.5; live audit rates it high via inherited libvips CVEs with the clean fix at 0.35.4 (semver-major within 0.x). Its only consumer is scripts/resize-image.js, which uses the stable resize/toFile API surface. Icon generation in the build runs through scripts/create-icons.js using the separate `canvas` package, so `npm run build` icon output is structurally unaffected; the acceptance check still verifies icons (or documents the canvas fallback).
analysis.details: The 0.34 -> 0.35 move is a 'major' only by 0.x convention; the used API (`sharp(path).resize(w, h, { fit: 'cover' }).toFile(out)`) is stable across these lines. Risk concentrates in the native binding swap: a fresh install must pull the 0.35.x prebuilt libvips binaries for the platform, so CI/dev environments need a clean `npm install` rather than a stale node_modules. Audit fix will not take this bump automatically (isSemVerMajor), which is why it is a separate issue from #15. No dependency on #15 except incidental lockfile adjacency — can land independently or ride the same dependency wave.
